title: Inna, Dima and Song
statementMd:
Inna is a great piano player and Dima is a modest guitar player. Dima has recently written a song and they want to play it together. Of course, Sereja wants to listen to the song very much.

A song is a sequence of notes. Dima and Inna want to play each note at the same time. At that, they can play the $*i*$-th note at volume $*v*$ ($1 ≤ *v* ≤ *a*_{*i*}$; $*v*$ is an integer) both on the piano and the guitar. They should retain harmony, so the total volume with which the $*i*$-th note was played on the guitar and the piano must equal $*b*_{*i*}$. If Dima and Inna cannot play a note by the described rules, they skip it and Sereja's joy drops by 1. But if Inna and Dima play the $*i*$-th note at volumes $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ $(*x*_{*i*} + *y*_{*i*} = *b*_{*i*})$ correspondingly, Sereja's joy rises by $*x*_{*i*}·*y*_{*i*}$.

Sereja has just returned home from the university and his current joy is 0. Help Dima and Inna play the song so as to maximize Sereja's total joy after listening to the whole song!

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of notes in the song. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$. The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$.

## Output

In a single line print an integer — the maximum possible joy Sereja feels after he listens to a song.

## Note

In the first sample, Dima and Inna play the first two notes at volume $1$ ($1 + 1 = 2$, the condition holds), they should play the last note at volumes $1$ and $2$. Sereja's total joy equals: $1·1 + 1·1 + 1·2 = 4$.

In the second sample, there is no such pair $(*x*, *y*)$, that $1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ 2$, $*x* + *y* = 5$, so Dima and Inna skip a note. Sereja's total joy equals -1.
statementZhMd:
英娜是一位出色的钢琴演奏家，而迪玛是一位谦逊的吉他手。最近，迪玛写了一首歌，他们想一起演奏。当然，谢列加非常想听这首歌。

一首歌是由一串音符组成的。迪玛和英娜想要同时演奏每个音符。对于第 $*i*$ 个音符，他们可以在钢琴和吉他上都以音量 $*v*$ 演奏（$1 ≤ *v* ≤ *a*_{*i*}$；$*v*$ 为整数）。为了保持和谐，第 $*i*$ 个音符在吉他和钢琴上的总音量必须等于 $*b*_{*i*}$。如果迪玛和英娜无法按照上述规则演奏某个音符，他们就跳过该音符，谢列加的愉悦值会下降 1。但如果英娜和迪玛分别以音量 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$ 演奏第 $*i*$ 个音符（$*x*_{*i*} + *y*_{*i*} = *b*_{*i*}$），谢列加的愉悦值就会增加 $*x*_{*i*}·*y*_{*i*}$。

谢列加刚从大学回到家，此时他的愉悦值为 0。请帮助迪玛和英娜演奏这首歌，使谢列加听完整首歌后的总愉悦值最大！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示歌曲中的音符数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数，即谢列加听完歌曲后可能获得的最大愉悦值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，迪玛和英娜以音量 1 演奏前两个音符（$1 + 1 = 2$，满足条件），他们应分别以音量 1 和 2 演奏最后一个音符。谢列加的总愉悦值为：$1·1 + 1·1 + 1·2 = 4$。

在第二个样例中，不存在满足 $1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ 2$ 且 $*x* + *y* = 5$ 的数对 $(*x*, *y*)$，因此迪玛和英娜跳过了该音符。谢列加的总愉悦值为 -1。
